_comment: Where each broker publishes its SEBI Annexure-B investor-complaint table.
SEBI requires every registered broker to publish monthly received / resolved /
pending complaint counts on its own website. The URL is curated here because
every broker puts it in a different place. THE NUMBERS ARE NEVER CURATED: they
are parsed from the broker's own page, and a page that cannot be parsed with
confidence produces no record at all.
VERIFICATION STATUS: these URLs are starting points and MUST be checked one by
one against each broker's live site before the data is published. Run
`python3 -m pipeline.run complaints` and read the gap log: a wrong URL shows up
as an unparsed broker, never as a wrong number. `verified` records the date a
human last confirmed the URL actually serves the Annexure-B table.
Add a broker by adding its id (must exist in brokers_master.json) and the URL
of the page carrying the table. If a broker publishes only a PDF, leave it out
for now and note it in `format`: PDF parsing is not implemented.

zerodha.note: Zerodha publishes complaint data under investor attention/charter.
